performance_execution: All timing benchmarks ran sequentially without other local build or compression work. Integration timings are not performance evidence.

relocation.scope: Export, evaluate, and realize an identical cgo checkout at a second location; first location built immediately beforehand; warm tools and dependencies; no remote lookups. Each revision/trial has a distinct module path.

dynamic_ci.scope: dynamic evaluation + realization; fresh planner, warm tools and Go package outputs; cache metadata queries follow the selected Nix settings

evaluation.scope: Warm graph evaluation; no builds; iets tracing cache and Nix fallback disabled

rebuild.scope: Rebuild every package with nix-build --check; warm tools, sources, and dependency outputs. No network transfer.

worker_closures.scope: Sum of NAR and zstd level 3 file sizes for complete closures; local binary cache, no network timing

cli_closure.scope: Complete CLI closures, local binary-cache zstd level 3; no network timing

upm_validation_script:
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
repo = Path('/tmp/drvgo-ci-buildids')
out = Path('/tmp/drvgo-canonical-id-upm-validation')
out.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
flags=['--extra-experimental-features','ca-derivations dynamic-derivations recursive-nix','--option','allow-import-from-derivation','false','--option','sandbox','true','--option','sandbox-fallback','false','--option','substituters','','--option','always-allow-substitutes','false','--max-jobs','4','--cores','2']
expression='''(import /tmp/drvgo-ci-buildids/nix/dynamic.nix {}) {
 name = "drvgo-canonical-upm-prepared";
 src = /nix/store/r3azknj8cz74gnw86kdq2jcjvg4vc1wd-source;
 package = "./cmd/upm";
 vendorHash = "sha256-A4CU4C5SmEZP6Q+CVHjp+Jy4UxRXAnpvhzrsdq4NlsM=";
 prepareModules = true;
}'''
(out/'prepared.nix').write_text(expression+'\n')
with (out/'prepared.log').open('w') as log:
 prepared=subprocess.check_output(['nix-build',*flags,'--no-out-link',str(out/'prepared.nix')],stderr=log,text=True).strip()
records=json.loads(Path('/tmp/drvgo-canonical-id-ci/results.json').read_text())['records']
defaults={r['command_output'] for r in records if r['label']=='after'}
standalone=Path('/tmp/drvgo-canonical-id-upm-store').read_text().strip()
assert defaults=={standalone} and str(Path(prepared).resolve())==standalone
cache='/nix/store/vcal7z7fvgv4gi7vxnhj3002vc4klsaq-drvgo-module-cache'
closure=subprocess.check_output(['nix-store','--query','--requisites',prepared],text=True).splitlines()
assert cache not in closure
version=subprocess.check_output([standalone+'/bin/upm','--version'],text=True).strip()
languages=subprocess.check_output([standalone+'/bin/upm','list-languages'],text=True).strip()
report={'package_count':len(json.loads(Path('/tmp/drvgo-canonical-id-upm-export/graph.json').read_text())['units']),
 'source_revision':'35a76c282507fb942445c0ee98427b3d1ef772bc','default_dynamic':list(defaults),
 'prepared_dynamic':prepared,'prepared_standalone':standalone,'all_modes_share_output':True,
 'prepared_cache_absent_from_runtime_closure':True,'version':version,'languages':languages,
 'before_prepared':'/nix/store/m3bkb484wbqkmbfh3c3761wj41kdw9p2-go-github.com-replit-upm-cmd-upm',
 'before_default':sorted({r['command_output'] for r in records if r['label']=='before'}),'flags':flags}
(out/'results.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(report,indent=2))
